bio.intro: AI Engineer based in Barcelona, building LLM/RAG systems that real people use, every day.
paragraphs: I currently lead generative-AI work at Hexamind — among other things, a chatbot serving 90,000+ users in production, built around RAG architectures and OpenAI under the hood.

My focus is the seam between research-grade AI and apps you can hand to a friend. I write a lot of Python, ship Flutter mobile apps on the side, and obsess over making technical things feel calm and a little playful.

travels.title: A year on the road, <italic>Hanoi to Tulum.</italic>
travels.prologue: The trip began as a pilgrimage — I have Vietnamese and Laotian roots, and I wanted to see with my own eyes the land my parents spoke of. Two months in Asia, then one thing led to another. I fell in love with backpacking, and went off for a year in South America, from Colombia to Brazil. Mexico closed the loop.
